{{< include _catalog_version.md >}}

This catalog lists the lessons available in the `{lhLessons}` package, which can be assembled into a course with `{lhCore}` (see [Set up lessons](2_setup_lessons.qmd)).  Click a lesson title to read the lesson, or use the tags to filter the table.  The tags are the same ones used by `search_lessons(tags = ...)`.

:::callout-note
The [National Center for Ecological Analysis and Synthesis (NCEAS)](https://www.nceas.ucsb.edu/){.external target="_blank"}, a research affiliate of UCSB, is a leading expert on interdisciplinary data science and works collaboratively to answer the world's largest and most complex questions. These written materials are the result of a continuous and collaborative effort at NCEAS to help researchers make their work more transparent and reproducible.  This work began in the early 2000's, and reflects the expertise and diligence of many, many individuals.
:::
